    BEAM_HEIGHT = 0.1
    DAMPING = 10.0  # High damping to slow down balls quickly
    
    # Vertical anchor to the ground
    vertical_anchor = sandbox.add_beam(x=7.1, y=5.5, width=0.1, height=0.1, density=BEAM_DENSITY)
    sandbox.add_joint(vertical_anchor, None, (7.1, GROUND_TOP), type="rigid")
    sandbox.set_material_properties(vertical_anchor, restitution=0.0)
    sandbox.set_damping(vertical_anchor, linear=DAMPING, angular=DAMPING)
    
    # Safe y positions for horizontal beams (avoiding sweeper bands)
    y_positions = [2.8, 3.6, 4.0, 5.0]
    
    for y in y_positions:
        # Create horizontal beams with increased density and damping
        horizontal_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=7.1, y=y, width=3.0, height=BEAM_HEIGHT, density=BEAM_DENSITY)
        sandbox.set_damping(horizontal_beam, linear=DAMPING, angular=DAMPING)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(horizontal_beam, restitution=0.0)
        
        # Connect to vertical anchor using rigid joints at the bottom of the horizontal beam
        pivot_y = y - (BEAM_HEIGHT / 2)
        pivot_point = (7.1, pivot_y)
        sandbox.add_joint(vertical_anchor, horizontal_beam, pivot_point, type="rigid")
    
    # Validate structural constraints
    n = len(sandbox.bodies)
    if n > sandbox.MAX_BEAM_COUNT:
        raise ValueError(f"Beam count {n} > {sandbox.MAX_BEAM_COUNT}")
    mass = sandbox.get_structure_mass()
    if mass >= sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS:
        raise ValueError(f"Mass {mass:.2f} must be < {sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS} kg")
    
    return vertical_anchor
